prompt.v: What is the perimeter of the triangle ABC with A (−1, −2), B (−3, −5), C (−7, −2), to 1 decimal place?

problems.explain: Each side is the distance between its corners: √(run² + rise²) for a slanted one. AB = √(2² + 3²) = √13 ≈ 3.606; BC = √(4² + 3²) = √25 = 5; CA = 6. Together about 14.606, which is 14.6 to 1 dp — round only at the end. (Adding the run and the rise of a slanted side walks round the corner, not along the side.) So 14.6.

AB = √(8² + 5²) = √89 ≈ 9.434; BC = 2; CD = √(3² + 6²) = √45 ≈ 6.708; DA = √(13² + 1²) = √170 ≈ 13.038. Together about 31.181, which is 31.2 to 1 dp — round only at the end. (Adding the run and the rise of a slanted side walks round the corner, not along the side.) So 31.2.
